title: Assistant agentic minimal frontend and enablement

criteria.statement: The frontend parser accepts assistant kind 30316 transcript events and kind 30315 agentic phase/action/tool fields without regressing legacy plan_hash plan parsing.

Assistant sessions subscribe to and render 30316 transcript entries plus 30315 agentic phases including tool_call_requested, tool_submitted, tool_observed, approval_required, blocked, and loop_completed.
approval_required statuses with action_id create a pending action approval UI and publish assistant/approval params {session_id, action_id, decision, reason}; plan_hash approvals continue to work.
E2E read-only assistant question completes without surfacing an approval UI.
E2E low-risk audited mutation displays tool submission and downstream Nostr observation without requiring approval.
E2E high-risk rollback displays approval_required and does not execute until the operator approves the action_id.
E2E relay close status renders blocked and later recovery events resume to loop_completed.
